sentiment.label: neutral
sentiment.reason_it: I mercati tradizionali sono chiusi per il fine settimana, ma osserviamo un sentiment neutrale con un VIX a 17.19 e un S&P 500 che ieri ha chiuso in positivo (+0.84%). Il DXY debole (-0.42%) e l'aumento del prezzo del petrolio (+1.23%) potrebbero influenzare il sentiment nella prossima settimana.
sentiment.reason_en: Traditional markets are closed for the weekend, but we observe a neutral sentiment with VIX at 17.19 and S&P 500 closing positive (+0.84%) yesterday. Weak DXY (-0.42%) and rising oil prices (+1.23%) could impact sentiment next week.

market_impact_summary.it: I mercati sono chiusi per il weekend, ma i dati di mercato attuali mostrano: EUR/USD a 1.17 (+0.50%), DXY a 97.84 (-0.42%), S&P 500 a 7398.93 (+0.84%), VIX a 17.19 (+0.64%), TLT a 86.08 (+0.50%), US 10Y Yield a 4.36% (-0.64%), GOLD a $4730.70/oz (+0.66%), Bitcoin a $80,775 (+0.14%), BRENT a $101.29 (+1.23%).
market_impact_summary.en: Markets are closed for the weekend, but current market data shows: EUR/USD at 1.17 (+0.50%), DXY at 97.84 (-0.42%), S&P 500 at 7398.93 (+0.84%), VIX at 17.19 (+0.64%), TLT at 86.08 (+0.50%), US 10Y Yield at 4.36% (-0.64%), GOLD at $4730.70/oz (+0.66%), Bitcoin at $80,775 (+0.14%), BRENT at $101.29 (+1.23%).

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in calo dello 0.19%, Shanghai stabile, e Hang Seng in calo dello 0.87%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura debole per i mercati europei, ma oggi sono chiusi per il fine settimana.

Nella seduta precedente, S&P 500 in rialzo dello 0.84%, VIX in aumento dello 0.64%, DXY in calo dello 0.42%. L'oro è salito dello 0.66% a $4730.7/oncia, il petrolio Brent in rialzo dell'1.23% a $101.29 I rendimenti dei titoli di stato: US 10Y Yield in calo dello 0.64% al 4.36%, BTP 10Y stabile al 3.39%.

La Cina ha registrato un aumento del 14% delle esportazioni a aprile, superando le aspettative. Gli Stati Uniti potrebbero imporre dazi doganali nonostante le critiche. Il presidente Trump potrebbe utilizzare le riserve strategiche di petrolio per affrontare la crisi.

Nessun dato macro rilevante in uscita oggi.

Mentre le borse mondiali osservano la consueta pausa festiva, i riflettori restano accesi sul comparto digitale, che opera 24 ore su 24 Bitcoin nella seduta precedente ha guadagnato lo 0.14% a $80,775 Il flusso netto degli ETF Bitcoin è stato di -$145.7M.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. Bitcoin si mantiene sopra gli ottantamila dollari, con una variazione del +0,72%. Tuttavia, i flussi ETF hanno registrato una uscita di 145,7 milioni di dollari. Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato da una maggiore cautela degli investitori dopo recenti dichiarazioni di analisti. Inoltre, gli analisti di Santiment segnalano un aumento del sentiment rialzista tra gli investitori, nonostante Bitcoin mantenga una posizione stabile sopra gli ottantamila dollari.

Le altcoin mostrano movimenti moderati. Ethereum guadagna lo 0,63% arrivando a duemilatrecento dollari, mentre Solana scende dello 0,18% a 93,54 dollari e BNB perde lo 0,20% arrivando a 648,52 dollari.

Il Fear & Greed Index è a 47, in zona neutrale, suggerisce quindi una sostanziale neutralità degli investitori.

Sui mercati attendiamo i dati economici in uscita. Per approfondire, trovate gli articoli sulla nostra piattaforma nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en:
Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. 

The Nikkei closed down 0.19%, Shanghai stable, and Hang Seng down 0.87%. This suggests a weak opening for European markets, but they are closed for the weekend today.

In the previous session, S&P 500 up 0.84%, VIX up 0.64%, DXY down 0.42%. Gold rose 0.66% to $4730.7/oz, Brent crude up 1.23% to $101.29 Government bond yields: US 10Y Yield down 0.64% to 4.36%, BTP 10Y stable at 3.39%.

China reported a 14% increase in exports in April, beating expectations. The US may impose customs duties despite criticism. President Trump could use strategic oil reserves to address the crisis.

No major macroeconomic data releases today.

While global stock markets observe the usual festive pause, the spotlight remains on the digital sector, which operates 24/7 Bitcoin in the previous session gained 0.14% to $80,775 The net flow of Bitcoin ETFs was -$145.7M.

Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets. Bitcoin holds above eighty thousand dollars, with a variation of +0.72%. However, ETF flows recorded an outflow of $145.7 million. This movement could be influenced by increased investor caution after recent analyst statements. Additionally, Santiment analysts report an increase in bullish sentiment among investors, despite Bitcoin maintaining a stable position above eighty thousand dollars.

Altcoins show moderate movements. Ethereum gains 0.63% to $2300, while Solana drops 0.18% to $93.54 and BNB loses 0.2% to $648.52

The Fear & Greed Index is at 47, in neutral territory, suggesting substantial investor neutrality.

We are awaiting economic data releases on the markets. For more details, find the articles on our platform in the Top Stories section. Thank you for your attention, and we'll see you tomorrow.

articles.title: How to Win a Trade War: Book launch and discussion with Bown and Keynes
articles.snippet: Soumaya Keynes and Chad P. Bown discuss their new book How to Win a Trade War, available for pre-order. Trade wars are here to stay, and refusing to engage in the fight is no longer an option. President Donald Trump's tariff announcements can crash markets and sour decades-long alliances. China's export restrictions on rare earths could bring the West's car production to a crashing halt. Curbs on trade in cutting-edge chips could determine who wins the artificial intelligence (AI) race. From identifying supply chain vulnerabilities to installing stockpiles, subsidies, and trade restrictions,…

articles.snippet: Learn how China's economy has evolved in recent years, ranging from its manufacturing exports sector to the massive housing boom and bust and more, with one of PIIE's top China experts, Senior Fellow Tianlei Huang. What can we learn from China's changing consumption and investment patterns? How did the housing market become so important to China's economy and what does its downfall mean moving forward? Huang explains all of this and more to host Anjali V. Bhatt, drawing on research from his forthcoming book, Detox: China's Fiscal Reckoning in the Shadow of the Housing Bust. HOST Anjali V.…

articles.title: Trump Could Tap Oil under U.S. Military Bases to Top Strategic Reserve
articles.snippet: The Trump Administration is looking for innovative ways to tap more crude from federal lands as the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) is being depleted again by emergency stock releases amid the global supply shock from the Iran war. One of these creative new ways to refill the SPR could be the potential tapping of oil from land at U.S. military bases or other sites of the Department of War, a source with knowledge of private information told Bloomberg this week.
